title: Restaurants Near Fort Lauderdale Boat Show
description: It’s about time that every boat enthusiast has been waiting for all year. That’s the 63rd annual Fort Lauderdale International Boat Show (FLIBS).
html:
It’s about time that every boat enthusiast has been waiting for all year. That’s the 63rd annual Fort Lauderdale International Boat Show (FLIBS). With so much ground to cover (six locations).

There is a long list of great places to eat near the boat show! And if you’re searching for a place to have drinks and appetizers, there are plenty of unique spots nearby. Fort Lauderdale offers some of the world’s best dining out. And many are right on-the-water!.

Below is an ultimate guide to dining near the Fort Lauderdale International Boat Show:

15th Street Fisheries

(Located inside Lauderdale Marina)
1900 SE 15th Street, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33316
954-763-2777

15th Street Fisheries is one of the best restaurants in Fort Lauderdale, renowned for offering the freshest seafood. You’ll enjoy delicious dinner, lunch, and drinks, including the best waterway views.

3030 Oceanic Restaurant

(Located at the Marriott Fort Lauderdale Harbor Beach Resort)
3030 Holiday Drive, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33316
954-765-3030

3030 Oceanic Restaurant offers you the best beachfront dining experience. You have the freedom to choose from various incredible brunch spots like Sea Level Restaurant and Ocean Bar.

Atmos Immersive Dining

(Located in Sistrunk Marketplace & Brewery)
115 NW 6th St, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33311
954-773-4358

Embark on an epic dining adventure that will spark your senses by visiting Atmos Immersive Dining. The restaurant offers some of the best cuisines in the region to satisfy your dining needs.

Boatyard

1555 SE 17th Street, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33316
954-525-7400

Visit the Boatyard Restaurant to explore world-class, elegant, yet tasty meals and drinks that will satisfy your cravings.

Boathouse At The Riverside

620 Southeast 4th Street, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33301
954-377-5494

Dine and dock at the Boathouse At The Riverside restaurant this coming FLIBS. You’ll enjoy a vibrant, relaxed, and fantastic waterfront dining experience.

Casablanca Cafe

3049 Alhambra Street, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33304
954-764-3500

Casablanca Café is one of the great places for lunch, breakfast, dessert, and dinner. Leverage their happy hour offer to save money and enjoy delicious meals.

Chima Steakhouse

Get a one-of-a-kind dining experience from Chima Steakhouse to make your Fort Lauderdale International Boat Show memorable. The restaurant provides top-notch appetizers, desserts, rodizios, and salad bars.

Dune by Auberge

(Located in Auberge Beach Residences)
2200 N Ocean Boulevard, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33305
754-900-4059

Dune by Auberge restaurant offers an elevated dining experience you can’t find anywhere in South Florida. Explore the exclusive menus prepared by globally-renowned Chef Tourondel.

Eve on the Water

1111 E Las Olas Boulevard, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33301
954-848-9900

Eve on the Water is one of the best brunch spots to enjoy foods packed with flavors in a relaxed, comfy atmosphere. Their menu comprises foods from different continents and cultures.

Even Keel Fish Shack

112 Commercial Boulevard, Suite A, Lauderdale-By-The-Sea, FL 33308
954-530-6276

Even Keel Fish Shack is a relaxed indoor/outdoor restaurant and bar in Fort Lauderdale. The restaurant sources all ingredients from the best local fisheries and farms for their cuisine.

Fishtales on 33rd

(Located in Galt Ocean Plaza)
3355 NE 33rd Street, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33308
954-689-2344

Fishtales on 33rd is a top-class restaurant with a comfy patio for outdoor drinking, dining, and holding a nightclub. It offers a perfect spot to relax in the evening after a long busy day of FLIBS sightings.

KAIZEN Sushi Bar & Grill

5640 N Federal Highway, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33308
954-835-5610

Visit KAIZEN Sushi Bar & Grill for tasty seafood/steak, gluten-free dishes, creative rolls, and fish from Japan. It’s a suitable restaurant to go to as an individual or with friends.

Lester’s Diner

250 W State Road 84, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33315
954-525-5641

Lester’s Diner is a perfect spot if you’re looking for the best traditional American Diner in South Florida. The restaurant offers desserts, sandwiches, breakfast, omelets, and appetizers.

Lobster Bar Sea Grille

(Located in Los Olas Centre I)
450 E Las Olas Boulevard, Suite 190, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33301
954-772-2675

Lobster Bar Sea Grille allows you to immerse yourself and explore rich menus. Be ready to dine on live lobsters, pristine seafood, and steak in a fresh, casual atmosphere.

Lona Cocina Teuleria

(Located in The Westin Fort Lauderdale Beach Resort)
321 N Fort Lauderdale Beach Boulevard, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33304
954-245-3069

Lona Cocina Teuileria is one of the best beaches in Fort Lauderdale. The restaurant offers authentic American cuisine elevated by vibrant Mexican flavors with a modern twist.

Marina 84 Sports Bar & Grill

2440 W State Road 84, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33312
954-734-2424

If you’re looking for the best restaurant that offers more than tasty cuisines, Marina 84 Sports Bar & Grill awaits you. The restaurant allows you to enjoy delicious meals and relax as you watch your favorite sports like NFL, NBA, NHL, Soccer, and Rugby.

Naked Crab

(Located in B Ocean Resort Fort Lauderdale)
1140 Seabreeze Boulevard, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33316
954-564-1000

Naked Crab is one of the best restaurants in Fort Lauderdale. The restaurant offers exceptional seafood authentic, local dining experience.

Park & Ocean

(Located in Hugh Taylor Birch State Park)
3109 E Sunrise Boulevard, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33304
954-357-2610

Take your FLIBS sighting to the next level by dining at Park & Ocean. It’s a spectacular restaurant with Caribbean and Southern-inspired menus, including remarkable oceanfront seating and views.

Rendezvous Bar & Grill

2525 Marina Bay Drive W, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33312
954-797-0054

Be ready to explore the extensive menu Rendezvous Bar & Grill offers. It’s among the best restaurants on the water to enjoy delicious daily lunch and nightly dinner specials.

Rocco’s Tacos & Tequila Bar

1313 E Las Olas Boulevard, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33301
954-524-9550

Visit Rocco’s Tacos & Tequila Bar for Mexican cuisine’s best yet authentic taste. The restaurant boasts a fun casual environment to keep you relaxed.

Salt7

500 E Las Olas Boulevard, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33301
954-751-7258

Salt7 is an incredible restaurant to enjoy the ultimate dining experience this coming FLIBS. It provides delicious dinner, brunch, and happy hour specials you will love.

Sea Watch On the Ocean

6002 N Ocean Boulevard, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33306
954-781-2200

Sea Watch On the Ocean is a prime spot to explore world-class menus. You’ll get the ultimate seafood dining experience.

Shooters Waterfront

3033 NE 32nd Avenue, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33308
954-566-2855

Shooters Waterfront restaurant offers fresh seafood to satisfy your cravings during the FLIBS. It provides excellent dockside views, lively events, and weekend brunch in a relaxed atmosphere.

Spazio

239 S Fort Lauderdale Beach Boulevard, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33316
954-559-0222

Spazio is a Restaurant and Wine Lounge of Italian origin. It provides a special touch of cuisines, drinks, and cocktails in the heart of Fort Lauderdale Beach.

Steak 954

401 N Fort Lauderdale Beach Boulevard, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33304
954-414-8333

Steak 954 is among the best restaurants in Fort Lauderdale. It offers various packages filled with excellent quality shellfish specials, wagyu beef, and tasty dishes.

The Terrace Grill

(Located in Element Fort Lauderdale Downtown)
299 N Federal Highway, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33301
954-945-9300

Open a new world of dining experiences offered by The Terrace Grill. The restaurant boasts trendy, tasteful, and savory cuisines to enjoy during the FLIBS.

The Wreck Bar

(Located in B Ocean Resort Fort Lauderdale)
1140 Seabreeze Boulevard, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33316
954-564-1000

Being the most notable lounge in Fort Lauderdale, The Wreck Bar provides tiki-influenced cocktails and seafood. Consider visiting this amazing restaurant during the FLIBS for the best dining experience.

Wild Sea Las Olas

620 E Las Olas Boulevard, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33301
954-467-2555

Wild Sea Las Olas is an excellent restaurant for relishing delicious cuisine. Its strategic location allows you to enjoy impeccable views of the city.

Attend the Fort Lauderdale International Boat Show in Style

Fort Lauderdale is an incredible city rich in restaurants offering exceptional cuisine. We hope this Boat Show Dining Guide helps you to enjoy your favorite meals throughout your visit.
